module: Test extension of the ExtensionProxy system. On load, it creates 11 ExtensionProxyTester objects (id 0 to 10) and submits them as "event sinks" to a proxy created by newExtensionProxy(M), so that the extension's hooks (such as onUpdate) are redistributed to each instance. Only useful to understand or debug this mechanism.
notes: onExtensionUnloaded calls extProxy:destroy(); the comment states that the extension system cleans up anyway.
In onExtensionLoaded, newExtensionProxyTester(id) receives a global variable id (nil) that the function ignores: the id is then set by hand (e.id = i).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on extension load. Creates 11 testers, an extension proxy, and submits the testers to it with submitEventSinks.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Called on extension unload. Destroys the extension proxy.

ExtensionProxyTester.desc: Test object with an id field; receives the hooks redistributed by the proxy.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: prints the tester's id and dtReal to the console.
